en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a metal bridge over a river with reflections in the water, trees along the banks, and two neoclassical multi‑story buildings in the background. The image is bordered by a blank area at the bottom containing printed and handwritten Greek and Latin‑alphabet text, including the place name. There is also a printed website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' across the lower right of the image.
